title: households: remove or suspend what the plugin did not create
setup: The setup household (id 1, the server admin's) and a second household made by the core (Serveur › Foyers).
expectBody: Every 'suspend <id>' and 'remove <id>' for a household the plugin did not create has ok: false. 'remove own' has ok: true.
afterInCore: Both core households still exist, not suspended, with all their profiles. The plugin-made household is removed (soft delete if the core keeps one).
decision: Antho 2026-11-08 11:35: suspend and resume, like remove, only for households the plugin created.
